gpu_pseudo_label_rule: 1 GPU unit if observed CPU utilization and observed memory consumption are both at or above their dataset 75th percentiles; otherwise 0
warnings: GPU labels are heuristic pseudo-labels, not measured GPU need or use.
Memory_Consumption is post-execution RAM use, not input file size. task_size_proxy_mb is retained for analysis and GPU-label construction but must not be used as a pre-execution model input.
CPU utilization and other target_* columns are observed outcomes and must not be used as pre-execution model inputs.
target_ram_allocated_mb is Memory_Share percent multiplied by VM memory capacity; it represents allocated RAM, not necessarily used RAM.
The dataset has no task file-size field and no measured GPU telemetry.
